title: Spicy Indian Tofu Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy Indian-inspired dish, perfect for a gluten-free meal. The spicy and nutty flavors complement the tender tofu and kebabs.
instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes.
In a bowl, mix together the spicy Indian nutty sauce, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and mix until well coated.
Thread the tofu and kebabs onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Serve with additional spicy Indian nutty sauce on the side, if desired.
